id: title:benjackwhite:share one theme store across usecharttheme callers

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces chart re-renders and DOM mutation listener overhead by sharing a single observer and theme object across charts with identical options, while retaining re-reads when the theme changes.
review.reason: The change replaces per-chart state and DOM observers with a shared, cached store and a single shared MutationObserver. This is a substantive bounded improvement: it reduces unnecessary re-renders and DOM listener overhead while preserving reactivity. The implementation and relevant checks are visible in P1.F3.H2 and P1.F3.H3. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow-only
review.uncertainty: The benefit is demonstrated by the shared-store and shared-observer implementation, but the actual runtime performance gain and its impact on user experience are not independently verified. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow-only. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow-only. No tier 3 systemic risk reduction or tier 1 narrow-only.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No score is assigned; tier assignment requires a score, not an observation-only JSON. The observations below describe the observed code and its PostHog connection, not a tier.

observations.behavior: Adds a shared, cached theme store and shared MutationObserver; the hook no longer creates a new observer or state per chart, and the README documents this. P1.F3.H3 replaces the per-chart useState and per-chart observer with useSyncExternalStore and a shared store. P1.F3.H2 adds the store, refresh, and subscription helpers. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 add cleanup and tests for shared-obs
